fee_notes: Single restaurant initial franchise fee is $50,000, paid upon signing the Franchise Agreement. Under certain circumstances, Fatburger may waive or reduce some or all of the Initial Fee, or accept payment in installments (interest free, 1–18 months). For Multi-Unit Restaurant Agreements, a development fee of $50,000 multiplied by the number of restaurants to be opened is required; a credit of $50,000 per Franchise Agreement is applied against the Initial Fee until the development fee is fully credited. Co-branded affiliate concepts (Buffalo's Café, Hurricane Grill & Wings, Hot Dog On A Stick, Round Table Pizza) each carry a separate $25,000 initial franchise fee charged by the respective affiliate, not by Fatburger. The Initial Fee is fully earned and non-refundable once paid.
raw_excerpt:
Single Restaurant
Initial Franchise Fees.  You must pay Fatburger an initial franchise fee (currently equal to $50,000) when you sign the Franchise Agreement (the "Initial Fee").
Adjustments.  Under certain circumstances, we will agree to waive or reduce some or all of the Initial Fee and may accept payment in installments, interest free, over a period of from one to 18 months.
